== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster raises power to 5 and deploy to 4. It expressly suspends Hoth Energy Shield Rules at his site for the rest of the turn, drops the other Whiphid modifiers and removes conditional battle destiny. The deployment-triggered Force loss remains.
